errors.text_span: Визуално секторът за „Концесии за услуги“ е разширен и изместен, за да се подчертаят неговите доминиращи пропорции
errors.evidence: The description claims that the largest slice ('Концесии за услуги') is expanded and shifted (exploded). The pie chart in the image is a standard, non-exploded chart where all slices are adjacent.

The description claims that each sector is labeled with the percentage written inside it. However, while the 79% label is inside its slice, the 18% and 3% labels are located outside their respective slices.
The description states that the legend is located in the bottom left corner. In the figure, the legend is positioned along the bottom of the chart, not confined to just the corner.
